council: Borough Council of King's Lynn and West Norfolk
current_evidence: The council's 'Planning application validation checklists' page links this Full Application checklist (id 9951) as the current one among 15 per-type checklists. The PDF text is dated 01/04/2026 v1 and cites the Local Plan 2021-2040. The council has no single combined local list; the per-type checklists are the local list.

issues.detail: The List date of 2026-08-01 comes from PDF metadata. The checklist text is dated 01/04/2026, version 1.

Local requirements in the Full Application checklist that Grokbot did not capture: Climate Change Statement (sites of 1 ha or more, Policy LP06); Affordable Housing Heads of Terms (LP28: 0.33 ha or 10+ dwellings in King's Lynn, Hunstanton, Downham Market; 0.165 ha or 5+ dwellings in rural areas); Custom and self-build Heads of Terms; Supporting Planning Statement (EIA, major and significant applications); Odour Assessment (commercial kitchens, takeaways, odour sources; Grokbot's odour text was misfiled as Air Quality); Local Plan policy compliance (all applications); Neighbourhood Plan submission requirements (where the parish plan sets them); BNG monitoring-fee Unilateral Undertaking with Land Registry title.
issues.evidence: Full Application checklist, Local Requirements section: 'Climate change statement ... 1 ha or more (Policy LP06)'; 'Affordable housing (Policy LP28) ... 0.33 ha or 10 or more dwellings ... rural ... 0.165 ha or 5 or more'

issues.detail: The Air Quality Assessment trigger is odour text ('This could include ... odour-guidance-2014.pdf the transport of odorous materials'). The actual Air Quality trigger is applications within the Gaywood Clock AQMA or the King's Lynn Town Centre one-way system / London Road AQMA.
issues.evidence: 'Air quality assessment: Required for applications within the Gaywood Clock AQMA or the King's Lynn Town Centre one-way system and London Road AQMA'

issues.detail: The Fire Statement triggers are wrong text. The Full planning excerpt ('Major application All development likely to affect: a) Internationally and nationally designated...') is the ecology trigger, and the Outline excerpt is the definition of reserved matters. The real trigger is buildings 18 m or more, or 7+ storeys, with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation.
issues.evidence: 'Fire statement: Required for buildings 18 m or more in height, or with 7 or more storeys, that contain two or more dwellings or educational accommodation'

issues.detail: Most trigger excerpts are column-merged text from the PDF tables, mixing several items so that thresholds are lost. Examples: Landscaping and Open Space ('Space Assessment Landscaping Details Noise Impact Assessment individually or cumulatively undermine...'); Lighting ('Structural Survey Lighting Scheme / Pollution Assessment A qualified Structural Engineer Light...'); Contaminated Land ('Contamination Assessment GIRAMS Land The Contaminated Land pages...'); Retail ('transport implications Retail Assessment Please see the NPPF Yes, if your proposal meets the following criteri...'), which omits the 2,500 sqm / Hardwick 500 sqm thresholds; Noise ('takeaways or, Noise Impact Assessment or acoustic reports should have reference'), which omits noisy plant/ASHP and noise-sensitive development; CIL ('find this CIL (Community Please see the CIL Pages...'), which omits 'more than 100 sqm or work already started'.
issues.evidence: Full checklist: Retail 'over 2,500 m2 outside existing service centres ... Hardwick ... 500 m2'; CIL 'If the work has already started or ... more than 100 square metres'

issues.detail: 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is placed under Full planning and Reserved matters using the lighting text 'floodlighting or illumination in the countryside', which is the Lighting Scheme trigger, not an advert requirement.
issues.evidence: Lighting scheme: 'materially increase light pollution (e.g., floodlighting or countryside illumination)'

issues.detail: For Householder, Grokbot read the 'Householder and Listed Building Consent' checklist (id 9946), not the plain 'Householder' checklist (id 9948). Its Householder rows (FRA/sequential test, heritage) apply to the combined HH+LBC route. The plain Householder checklist's only local items are CIL, Local Plan compliance and Neighbourhood Plan requirements, and Grokbot captured neither of the last two. Grokbot also did not read the Listed Building checklist (id 9943), the LDC existing checklist (9952), the Tree Application checklist (9954) or the Variation (Listed Building) checklist (9949), so Listed building consent and Works to trees are wrongly shown as '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Validation checklists page lists 'Householder' (id 9948), 'Listed Building' (id 9943), 'Tree Application' (id 9954)

issues.detail: 'Change of use - prior approval' rows copy the Householder and LBC checklist items (Roof plan, Heritage, FRA/sequential test, CIL). The council's prior-notification checklist read was the Agricultural Prior Notification one, so these items are mis-assigned.
issues.evidence: Prior approval rows have identical excerpts to the Householder rows ('Roof Plan – to a scale of 1:100 PLEASE DO NOT MARK DRAWINGS...')

issues.detail: Discharge of conditions rows are mislabelled pieces of the surface-water drainage checklist. 'Highways / access details' is watercourse maintenance text, 'Planning Obligations / S106 Heads of Terms' is a reference to Section 106 of the Water Industry Act 1991 (sewer connection), and 'Ground investigation' is hydrogeological context.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Water under Section 106 of the Water Industry Act 1991.'

issues.detail: The 8 'Drawing / document standards' tab_items are national plan-scale text with fee-calculator boilerplate merged in ('You can calculate your fee via the Planning Portal The Plan should...'), largely duplicated. The 'Submission rules' item is the misfiled odour fragment, and 'Local forms / checklists' is a SuDS evidence fragment.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'Yes You can calculate your fee via the Planning Portal The Plan should, in most cases, be to a scale of either 1:1250 or 1:2500...'

issues.detail: 'Floor plans / Elevations' and 'Roof plan' rows share the same excerpt under several application types (Householder, Full, Reserved matters, Prior approval), and 'Existing and proposed site levels' under s73 repeats the BNG excerpt. These are national drawing requirements rather than local ones.
issues.evidence: Householder rows: Roof plan and Floor plans both 'Roof Plan – to a scale of 1:100 PLEASE DO NOT MARK DRAWINGS...'

issues.detail: Several rows are national requirements labelled as local: BNG, Fire Statement, Heritage Statement, Ecology, Design and Access Statement and CIL appear under the checklist's 'National Requirements' heading. The local-only items (GIRAMS/HRA, affordable housing, climate change, odour, AQMA and others) should be distinguished.
issues.evidence: Full checklist splits 'National Requirements' and 'Local Requirements' sections

summary: Grokbot's link is King's Lynn and West Norfolk's current Full Application checklist (text dated 01/04/2026; the date is from metadata). The extraction misses several local items (climate change statement, affordable housing thresholds, odour, AQMA trigger, local/neighbourhood plan compliance), and many triggers are column-merged or misattributed. Grokbot also skipped the plain Householder, Listed Building and Tree checklists.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
